name: Fish ID
subtitle: Identify, learn and keep finds
keywords: fish identifier,fish species id,fishing guide,offline,nature,field guide,freshwater
description:
Photograph a fish from the side or choose a picture from your library. Fish ID analyses the image on your device. Its iNaturalist model can suggest 17 fish species, including largemouth bass, northern pike, rainbow trout and the Moorish idol. Check the visible markings before confirming a name. When the image gives no reliable match, choose a species yourself.

Explore 22 illustrated profiles. Learn to recognise a pumpkinseed by its gill flap, a channel catfish by its forked tail and a yellow perch by its dark bars. Compare any two species by their markings, typical length and habitat. Search by common or scientific name and keep favourites for your next trip.

Your private notebook stores photos, dates and field notes on this device. Revisit an observation, edit its note or save a field card to Photos. Weekly activity, a seasonal challenge and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep your recent finds close.

The model, guide and sample rainbow trout photograph are included, ready to use offline. The dated fishing reference covers Florida freshwater rules. Check the current rules for the water you visit.
